stations.title: Winnie
stations.say: Who owns Biscuit? I need a number.

stations.title: animals
stations.text: Biscuit's row has an owner id, not a name.

captions: Winnie has found Biscuit, and now she needs his owner while the caller waits.
The animal is in one table and the owner in another, so she hunts through both by hand.
You join two tables on the id that links them, in four tasks.
Now each animal sits on one row with its owner, and Winnie answers at once.
Same tables, now read together. One query crosses from one to the other.
